name: availability-admin
title: The admin service is unavailable
description: The external admin health check has reported the service as unhealthy during each of the last three minutes.
investigation_steps: Open the admin health-check endpoint and confirm whether it responds.
Check the admin load balancer, target group and ECS service health. Try hitting the admin service directly to see if it responds.
If the service is unavailable, escalate this as soon as possible, an incident will likely need to be raised if this is the case.
